表示适应；to 后接新环境、变化或 doing。

example.text: Marketing, management and creative thinking skills can help students adapt to a changing job market.

c-sentence-02-048-f.pattern: Flexibility can help people respond to rapid changes, including developments in artificial intelligence and machine learning.
collocations: help + 人 + (to) do / help with + 事情

help 接动作时可省略 to；接事情可使用 with，不写 help someone doing。

example.text: Flexibility can help people respond to rapid changes, including developments in artificial intelligence and machine learning.

c-sentence-03-000.pattern: Sound, images and visual effects can gain attention, maintain students' interest and stimulate enthusiasm for learning.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: Sound, images and visual effects can gain attention, maintain students' interest and stimulate enthusiasm for learning.

c-sentence-03-001.pattern: Watching suitable programmes or playing games in moderation may develop interests and inspire further reading on a topic.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: Watching suitable programmes or playing games in moderation may develop interests and inspire further reading on a topic.
example.translation: 适度观看合适的节目或玩游戏，可能培养兴趣，并激发对某个主题的进一步阅读。

c-sentence-03-004.pattern: Educational media can help students gain extracurricular knowledge and access a broad range of information.
collocations: a wide / broad range of + 复数名词或不可数名词
help + 人 + (to) do / help with + 事情
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
表示多种或广泛的事物；of 后要补全类别，本条本身不能单独构成完整论点。
help 接动作时可省略 to；接事情可使用 with，不写 help someone doing。

example.text: Educational media can help students gain extracurricular knowledge and access a broad range of information.
example.translation: 教育媒体可以帮助学生获得课外知识，接触广泛的信息。

c-sentence-03-005.pattern: Educational programmes can go beyond subject knowledge to cover social issues closely related to the real world.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: Educational programmes can go beyond subject knowledge to cover social issues closely related to the real world.
example.translation: 教育节目可以超越学科知识，涵盖与现实世界密切相关的社会问题。

c-sentence-03-008.pattern: Well-designed activities can improve literacy levels by raising children's phonological awareness.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: Well-designed activities can improve literacy levels by raising children's phonological awareness.
example.translation: 设计良好的活动可以通过提高儿童的语音意识，帮助提升读写能力。

c-sentence-03-015.pattern: Learning to communicate with others online develops a practical skill that students may use in their future work.
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
with 引出交流对象；交流内容可用 about + 话题补充。

example.text: Learning to communicate with others online develops a practical skill that students may use in their future work.
example.translation: 学习在线与他人交流，可以培养学生未来工作中可能用到的一项实用技能。

c-sentence-03-016.pattern: Students can become familiar with everyday computer tasks, such as downloading programmes and installing software.
collocations: become / get familiar with + 事物
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
表示逐渐熟悉某事；with 引出所熟悉的对象。

example.text: Students can become familiar with everyday computer tasks, such as downloading programmes and installing software.
example.translation: 学生可以熟悉下载程序、安装软件等日常电脑操作。

c-sentence-03-017.pattern: Students need to navigate the Internet effectively to complete assignments and conduct research.
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
to 后用动词原形；保留前面动词所表达的需要、尝试或倾向。

example.text: Students need to navigate the Internet effectively to complete assignments and conduct research.
example.translation: 学生需要有效地浏览互联网，以完成作业和开展研究。

c-sentence-03-027.pattern: Receiving information passively may reduce active mental engagement and leave fewer opportunities for creative thinking.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: Receiving information passively may reduce active mental engagement and leave fewer opportunities for creative thinking.
example.translation: 被动接收信息可能减少主动思考，让创造性思维得到锻炼的机会变少。

c-sentence-03-028.pattern: When media present every detail directly, they may leave little room for imagination and limit opportunities to develop imaginative skills.
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
when 引出时间或条件，注意它与主句的对应关系。
表示做某事的机会；不定式说明机会的内容。

example.text: When media present every detail directly, they may leave little room for imagination and limit opportunities to develop imaginative skills.
example.translation: 当媒体直接呈现所有细节时，可能留给想象的空间很少，并限制想象力得到锻炼的机会。

c-sentence-03-029.pattern: Reading asks people to infer images from words, exercising imagination and creativity in ways that may be less necessary when watching television.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
when 引出时间或条件，注意它与主句的对应关系。

example.text: Reading asks people to infer images from words, exercising imagination and creativity in ways that may be less necessary when watching television.
example.translation: 阅读要求人们从文字推想画面，以观看电视时可能较少需要的方式锻炼想象力和创造力。

c-sentence-03-030.pattern: A lack of opportunities to produce language can make it harder to improve speaking and writing skills.
collocations: a lack of / a shortage of + 事物
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
表示做某事的机会；不定式说明机会的内容。
表示缺少；lack 作动词时后直接接宾语，不加 of。

example.text: A lack of opportunities to produce language can make it harder to improve speaking and writing skills.
example.translation: 缺少语言输出机会，会使提高口语和写作能力变得更加困难。

c-sentence-03-031.pattern: Games that require only short-term focus may make sustained classroom attention harder for some children, but this alone does not establish that games cause attention deficit disorders.
collocations: 按动词含义选择对象 + to do
enable / allow / encourage / require + 人 + to do
原因或行为 + 因果表达 + 结果
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
enable 表示使能够，allow 表示允许，encourage 表示鼓励，require 表示要求，motivate 表示激励。
接人的动作时用对象 + to do；若直接接名词，则表示促进、允许或要求某事。
区分“导致”与“有助于”；用于论证时需要说明机制，不能仅靠搭配认定因果。

example.text: Games that require only short-term focus may make sustained classroom attention harder for some children, but this alone does not establish that games cause attention deficit disorders.
example.translation: 只需短期注意力的游戏，可能使部分孩子更难在课堂上持续专注，但仅凭这一点不能认定游戏会导致注意缺陷障碍。

c-sentence-03-032.pattern: Teachers who rely entirely on multimedia may overlook important parts of the curriculum.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: Teachers who rely entirely on multimedia may overlook important parts of the curriculum.
example.translation: 完全依赖多媒体的教师，可能忽略课程中的重要内容。

c-sentence-03-034.pattern: Heavily commercialised programmes may encourage impulsive buying.
collocations: 按动词含义选择对象 + to do
enable / allow / encourage / require + 人 + to do
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
enable 表示使能够，allow 表示允许，encourage 表示鼓励，require 表示要求，motivate 表示激励。
接人的动作时用对象 + to do；若直接接名词，则表示促进、允许或要求某事。

example.text: Heavily commercialised programmes may encourage impulsive buying.
example.translation: 商业化程度很高的节目可能诱发冲动消费。

c-sentence-03-035.pattern: Targeted advertising on Internet platforms may create artificial desires or needs among children.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: Targeted advertising on Internet platforms may create artificial desires or needs among children.
example.translation: 互联网平台上的定向广告，可能在儿童中制造人为的欲望或需求。

c-sentence-03-040.pattern: Prolonged gaming can involve repetitive, strenuous movements of the hands and wrists, which may contribute to inflammation or injury.
collocations: contribute to + 名词 / 动名词
原因或行为 + 因果表达 + 结果
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
which 引出对前面事物或情况的补充说明。
to 是介词；表示促成或有助于某事，后可接 doing。
区分“导致”与“有助于”；用于论证时需要说明机制，不能仅靠搭配认定因果。

example.text: Prolonged gaming can involve repetitive, strenuous movements of the hands and wrists, which may contribute to inflammation or injury.
example.translation: 长时间玩游戏可能涉及手和腕部重复、费力的动作，从而增加发炎或受伤的风险。

c-sentence-03-041.pattern: Excessive screen time may reduce time for sleep and exercise, contributing to poorer physical health.
collocations: contribute to + 名词 / 动名词
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
to 是介词；表示促成或有助于某事，后可接 doing。

example.text: Excessive screen time may reduce time for sleep and exercise, contributing to poorer physical health.
example.translation: 过度使用屏幕可能减少睡眠和运动时间，从而损害身体健康。

c-sentence-04-000.pattern: An economic revival may make some workers less concerned about job security.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: An economic revival may make some workers less concerned about job security.
example.translation: 经济复苏可能使一些劳动者不再那么担忧工作稳定性。

c-sentence-04-001.pattern: Emerging industries can create new jobs.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: Emerging industries can create new jobs.

c-sentence-04-002.pattern: A recovering job market may offer workers more opportunities to change careers.

表示做某事的机会；不定式说明机会的内容。

example.text: A recovering job market may offer workers more opportunities to change careers.
example.translation: 正在回暖的就业市场，可能为劳动者提供更多转行机会。

c-sentence-04-006.pattern: A well-paid job can increase employees' purchasing power beyond basic needs such as food and accommodation.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: A well-paid job can increase employees' purchasing power beyond basic needs such as food and accommodation.
example.translation: 高薪工作可以提高员工在食物、住房等基本需求之外的购买力。

c-sentence-04-007.pattern: A more specialised division of labour may create clearer career pathways and make switching jobs less challenging for some workers.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: A more specialised division of labour may create clearer career pathways and make switching jobs less challenging for some workers.
example.translation: 更加专业化的劳动分工，可能形成更清晰的职业路径，使部分劳动者换工作更加容易。

c-sentence-04-008.pattern: Technological advancement can eliminate some low-skilled positions while creating demand for new skills.
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
while 可表示对照或同时发生；根据句意判断两部分关系。
名词后用 for 引出需求对象；作动词时一般直接接宾语。

example.text: Technological advancement can eliminate some low-skilled positions while creating demand for new skills.
example.translation: 技术进步可能淘汰一些低技能岗位，同时创造对新技能的需求。

c-sentence-04-014.pattern: Excessively long commuting times may encourage employees to look for work closer to home.
collocations: 按动词含义选择对象 + to do
动词 + 对象 + to do
enable / allow / encourage / require + 人 + to do
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
enable 表示使能够，allow 表示允许，encourage 表示鼓励，require 表示要求，motivate 表示激励。
说明让谁做什么；to 后用动词原形，保留前面的对象。
接人的动作时用对象 + to do；若直接接名词，则表示促进、允许或要求某事。

example.text: Excessively long commuting times may encourage employees to look for work closer to home.
example.translation: 过长的通勤时间可能促使员工寻找离家更近的工作。

c-sentence-04-017.pattern: Switching jobs can help people identify a career path that better suits their interests and abilities.
collocations: help + 人 + (to) do / help with + 事情
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
help 接动作时可省略 to；接事情可使用 with，不写 help someone doing。

example.text: Switching jobs can help people identify a career path that better suits their interests and abilities.
example.translation: 换工作可以帮助人们找到更符合其兴趣和能力的职业道路。

c-sentence-04-029.pattern: Workers whose previous jobs were seasonal or temporary may seek full-time employment for greater stability.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: Workers whose previous jobs were seasonal or temporary may seek full-time employment for greater stability.
example.translation: 此前从事季节性或临时工作的劳动者，可能为了更加稳定而寻找全职工作。

c-sentence-04-032.pattern: When a company is restructured, some departments may be eliminated.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
when 引出时间或条件，注意它与主句的对应关系。

example.text: When a company is restructured, some departments may be eliminated.
example.translation: 公司重组时，一些部门可能被撤销。

c-sentence-04-033.pattern: When a company downsizes, employees who lack the required qualifications may have their contracts terminated.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
when 引出时间或条件，注意它与主句的对应关系。

example.text: When a company downsizes, employees who lack the required qualifications may have their contracts terminated.
example.translation: 公司裁员时，不具备所需资历的员工可能遭到解约。

c-sentence-04-035.pattern: Labour mobility can support a more efficient allocation of the workforce.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: Labour mobility can support a more efficient allocation of the workforce.
example.translation: 劳动力流动可以支持人力资源更加有效的配置。

c-sentence-04-036.pattern: Companies can use headhunting to recruit more experienced workers.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: Companies can use headhunting to recruit more experienced workers.
example.translation: 公司可以通过猎头招聘更有经验的员工。

c-sentence-04-042.pattern: Employees may consider leaving when their personal values no longer align with organisational goals.
collocations: avoid / enjoy / consider + 名词或 doing
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
when 引出时间或条件，注意它与主句的对应关系。
如果后面表示动作，用动名词，通常不接 to do。

example.text: Employees may consider leaving when their personal values no longer align with organisational goals.
example.translation: 当个人价值观不再与组织目标一致时，员工可能考虑离职。

c-sentence-04-047.pattern: Frequent unexplained job changes may weaken a candidate's CV because some employers prefer applicants with a record of stability.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
because 引出原因从句，要保留主语和谓语。

example.text: Frequent unexplained job changes may weaken a candidate's CV because some employers prefer applicants with a record of stability.
example.translation: 频繁且缺乏合理解释的跳槽，可能削弱简历的说服力，因为一些雇主偏好工作经历稳定的申请者。

c-sentence-04-052.pattern: Greater population mobility can create new challenges for public security management if local services fail to adapt.

if 引出条件，避免把有条件的结论写成绝对结论。
to 后用动词原形；保留前面动词所表达的需要、尝试或倾向。

example.text: Greater population mobility can create new challenges for public security management if local services fail to adapt.
example.translation: 如果地方服务未能及时适应，更大的人口流动可能给公共安全管理带来新的挑战。

c-sentence-04-053.pattern: An influx of young people into cities can increase demand for jobs and housing.

名词后用 for 引出需求对象；作动词时一般直接接宾语。

example.text: An influx of young people into cities can increase demand for jobs and housing.
example.translation: 大量年轻人涌入城市，可能增加对工作和住房的需求。

notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: Traditional social contexts can shape expectations about gender roles.
example.translation: 传统社会环境可能塑造对性别角色的期待。

c-sentence-06-016.pattern: Media portrayals of men and women as fundamentally different can reinforce accepted social norms rather than reflect every individual's experience.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: Media portrayals of men and women as fundamentally different can reinforce accepted social norms rather than reflect every individual's experience.
example.translation: 媒体将男性和女性描述为根本不同，可能强化既有社会规范，而不是反映每个人的经历。

c-sentence-06-024.pattern: Technological developments can reduce the physical demands of some jobs and create opportunities for women to become more independent.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: Technological developments can reduce the physical demands of some jobs and create opportunities for women to become more independent.
example.translation: 技术发展可以降低一些工作的体力要求，为女性更加独立创造机会。

c-sentence-06-025.pattern: Labour shortages provide an additional reason to remove barriers that prevent women from participating fully in the workforce.
collocations: protect / prevent + 对象 + from + 名词或 doing
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
from 后写风险或阻止发生的行为；不要漏掉前面的对象。

example.text: Labour shortages provide an additional reason to remove barriers that prevent women from participating fully in the workforce.
example.translation: 劳动力短缺提供了又一理由，促使社会消除妨碍女性充分参与工作的障碍。

c-sentence-06-026.pattern: Narrowing gender gaps in employment can promote economic development.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: Narrowing gender gaps in employment can promote economic development.
example.translation: 缩小就业中的性别差距可以促进经济发展。

c-sentence-07-000.pattern: Older people can make significant economic contributions through taxation, saving and spending.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: Older people can make significant economic contributions through taxation, saving and spending.
example.translation: 老年人可以通过纳税、储蓄和消费作出重要经济贡献。

c-sentence-07-002.pattern: Many families, communities and organisations benefit from older people's skills, knowledge and experience.
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
from 引出受益来源；benefit someone 则是使某人受益。

example.text: Many families, communities and organisations benefit from older people's skills, knowledge and experience.
example.translation: 许多家庭、社区和组织受益于老年人的技能、知识和经验。

c-sentence-07-005.pattern: Some people continue teaching or conducting research beyond the official retirement age.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: Some people continue teaching or conducting research beyond the official retirement age.
example.translation: 一些人在法定退休年龄之后仍继续教学或开展研究。

c-sentence-07-006.pattern: Although ageist stereotypes portray older people as less energetic or enterprising, many provide care and support by looking after grandchildren, doing housework, shopping and running errands.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
although 引出让步，主句说明限制条件下仍成立的观点。

example.text: Although ageist stereotypes portray older people as less energetic or enterprising, many provide care and support by looking after grandchildren, doing housework, shopping and running errands.
example.translation: 尽管年龄偏见把老年人描述为缺乏活力或进取心，许多人仍通过照看孙辈、做家务、购物和跑腿提供照顾与支持。

c-sentence-07-007.pattern: Older people can serve as living repositories of knowledge, a role often associated with wisdom before the information age.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: Older people can serve as living repositories of knowledge, a role often associated with wisdom before the information age.
example.translation: 老年人可以成为活的知识库，这一角色在信息时代之前常与智慧相联系。

c-sentence-07-013.pattern: Advances in contraception and medicine give people more reproductive choices, while accessible medical insurance can support timely treatment.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
while 可表示对照或同时发生；根据句意判断两部分关系。

example.text: Advances in contraception and medicine give people more reproductive choices, while accessible medical insurance can support timely treatment.
example.translation: 避孕和医学的进步让人们拥有更多生育选择，而可获得的医疗保险可以支持及时治疗。

c-sentence-07-014.pattern: Greater health awareness may encourage habits that support a longer and healthier life.
collocations: 按动词含义选择对象 + to do
enable / allow / encourage / require + 人 + to do
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
enable 表示使能够，allow 表示允许，encourage 表示鼓励，require 表示要求，motivate 表示激励。
接人的动作时用对象 + to do；若直接接名词，则表示促进、允许或要求某事。

example.text: Greater health awareness may encourage habits that support a longer and healthier life.
example.translation: 更强的健康意识可能鼓励有助于延长健康寿命的生活习惯。

c-sentence-07-015.pattern: Greater autonomy allows women to decide whether they want children, including choosing not to give birth.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: Greater autonomy allows women to decide whether they want children, including choosing not to give birth.
example.translation: 更大的自主权让女性能够决定是否要孩子，包括选择不生育。

c-sentence-07-016.pattern: Changing views of marriage and family have made remaining single or choosing a dual-income household without children more acceptable in some communities.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: Changing views of marriage and family have made remaining single or choosing a dual-income household without children more acceptable in some communities.
example.translation: 婚姻和家庭观念的变化，使保持单身或选择双收入无子女家庭在一些社区更被接受。

c-sentence-07-017.pattern: Women seeking career advancement may be unwilling to give up their jobs when deciding whether to have children.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
when 引出时间或条件，注意它与主句的对应关系。

example.text: Women seeking career advancement may be unwilling to give up their jobs when deciding whether to have children.
example.translation: 追求职业发展的女性，在决定是否生育时，可能不愿放弃自己的工作。

c-sentence-07-019.pattern: Mounting pressures in urban life may make some people reluctant to raise children.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: Mounting pressures in urban life may make some people reluctant to raise children.
example.translation: 城市生活中不断增长的压力，可能使一些人不愿养育孩子。

c-sentence-07-021.pattern: Rising urban housing costs and longer periods in higher education may delay marriage and childbirth, while an ageing workforce can contribute to labour shortages in some industries.
collocations: contribute to + 名词 / 动名词
原因或行为 + 因果表达 + 结果
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
while 可表示对照或同时发生；根据句意判断两部分关系。
to 是介词；表示促成或有助于某事，后可接 doing。
区分“导致”与“有助于”；用于论证时需要说明机制，不能仅靠搭配认定因果。

example.text: Rising urban housing costs and longer periods in higher education may delay marriage and childbirth, while an ageing workforce can contribute to labour shortages in some industries.
example.translation: 城市住房成本上升和接受高等教育时间延长，可能推迟婚育，而劳动力老龄化可能加剧一些行业的人手短缺。

c-sentence-07-027.pattern: A shortage of skilled workers may weaken a country's international competitiveness.
collocations: a lack of / a shortage of + 事物
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
表示缺少；lack 作动词时后直接接宾语，不加 of。

example.text: A shortage of skilled workers may weaken a country's international competitiveness.
example.translation: 技术工人短缺可能削弱一个国家的国际竞争力。

c-sentence-07-028.pattern: People planning for longer retirements may spend less and save more, which can reduce demand in a consumption-driven economy.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
which 引出对前面事物或情况的补充说明。

example.text: People planning for longer retirements may spend less and save more, which can reduce demand in a consumption-driven economy.
example.translation: 为更长退休期作准备的人可能减少消费、增加储蓄，这可能降低消费驱动型经济中的需求。

c-sentence-07-029.pattern: Greater demand for healthcare can put pressure on a country's health system if capacity does not expand.
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
if 引出条件，避免把有条件的结论写成绝对结论。
名词后用 for 引出需求对象；作动词时一般直接接宾语。

example.text: Greater demand for healthcare can put pressure on a country's health system if capacity does not expand.
example.translation: 如果服务能力没有扩大，更大的医疗需求可能给一个国家的医疗系统带来压力。

c-sentence-07-031.pattern: Higher pension costs can place an additional financial burden on the state.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: Higher pension costs can place an additional financial burden on the state.
example.translation: 更高的养老金成本可能给国家带来额外的财政负担。

c-sentence-07-034.pattern: More accessible public facilities can make a meaningful difference to older people's daily lives.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: More accessible public facilities can make a meaningful difference to older people's daily lives.
example.translation: 更便于使用的公共设施，可以切实改善老年人的日常生活。

c-sentence-07-035.pattern: Communities can organise activities that teach older residents how to use electronic devices.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: Communities can organise activities that teach older residents how to use electronic devices.
example.translation: 社区可以组织活动，教老年居民使用电子设备。

c-sentence-07-037.pattern: Hospitals and nursing homes can provide professional care when families need additional support.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
when 引出时间或条件，注意它与主句的对应关系。

example.text: Hospitals and nursing homes can provide professional care when families need additional support.
example.translation: 家庭需要额外支持时，医院和护理机构可以提供专业照护。

c-sentence-07-039.pattern: Raising the retirement age may increase labour supply, tax revenue and consumer spending, but policies should consider differences in health and job demands.
collocations: avoid / enjoy / consider + 名词或 doing
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
如果后面表示动作，用动名词，通常不接 to do。

example.text: Raising the retirement age may increase labour supply, tax revenue and consumer spending, but policies should consider differences in health and job demands.
example.translation: 提高退休年龄可能增加劳动力供给、税收和消费支出，但政策应考虑健康状况和岗位要求的差异。

c-sentence-07-042.pattern: Welfare policies such as child benefits can lower the cost of raising children, while community programmes can invite elders to share personal histories and life experiences as cultural bearers.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
while 可表示对照或同时发生；根据句意判断两部分关系。

example.text: Welfare policies such as child benefits can lower the cost of raising children, while community programmes can invite elders to share personal histories and life experiences as cultural bearers.
example.translation: 儿童津贴等福利政策可以降低育儿成本，而社区项目可以邀请长者作为文化传承者分享个人历史和人生经历。

c-sentence-08-004.pattern: Closer cultural and commercial links, together with less restrictive travel visa requirements, can make international tourism more accessible.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: Closer cultural and commercial links, together with less restrictive travel visa requirements, can make international tourism more accessible.
example.translation: 更紧密的文化和商业联系，以及更宽松的旅游签证要求，可以让国际旅游更容易实现。

c-sentence-08-005.pattern: Improvements in cross-border transport can make international journeys faster and safer.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: Improvements in cross-border transport can make international journeys faster and safer.
example.translation: 跨境交通的改善可以让国际旅行更快捷、更安全。

c-sentence-08-009.pattern: Some members of the millennial generation are keen to travel abroad, although preferences differ within every age group.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
although 引出让步，主句说明限制条件下仍成立的观点。

example.text: Some members of the millennial generation are keen to travel abroad, although preferences differ within every age group.
example.translation: 一些千禧一代成员热衷于出国旅游，但每个年龄群体内部的偏好都有差异。

c-sentence-08-010.pattern: Awareness that a destination is threatened may motivate people to visit before it changes, potentially adding pressure to a vulnerable place.
collocations: 按动词含义选择对象 + to do
动词 + 对象 + to do
enable / allow / encourage / require + 人 + to do
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
enable 表示使能够，allow 表示允许，encourage 表示鼓励，require 表示要求，motivate 表示激励。
说明让谁做什么；to 后用动词原形，保留前面的对象。
接人的动作时用对象 + to do；若直接接名词，则表示促进、允许或要求某事。

example.text: Awareness that a destination is threatened may motivate people to visit before it changes, potentially adding pressure to a vulnerable place.
example.translation: 意识到某个目的地正受到威胁，可能促使人们趁它改变之前前往，同时也可能增加脆弱地区的压力。

c-sentence-08-011.pattern: Travelling abroad can push people out of their comfort zone as they learn to navigate an unfamiliar environment.
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
to 后用动词原形；保留前面动词所表达的需要、尝试或倾向。

example.text: Travelling abroad can push people out of their comfort zone as they learn to navigate an unfamiliar environment.
example.translation: 出国旅行可以促使人们走出舒适区，学会应对陌生环境。

c-sentence-08-013.pattern: A holiday can offer a break from the hustle and bustle and help people approach daily life with a different mindset.
collocations: help + 人 + (to) do / help with + 事情
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
help 接动作时可省略 to；接事情可使用 with，不写 help someone doing。

example.text: A holiday can offer a break from the hustle and bustle and help people approach daily life with a different mindset.
example.translation: 度假可以让人暂时远离喧嚣，以不同的心态面对日常生活。

c-sentence-08-014.pattern: Tourism can strengthen international connections and create opportunities for business and cultural collaboration.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: Tourism can strengthen international connections and create opportunities for business and cultural collaboration.
example.translation: 旅游可以加强国际联系，创造商业和文化合作的机会。

c-sentence-08-023.pattern: Learning about local values and norms can help visitors develop cultural sensitivity.
collocations: help + 人 + (to) do / help with + 事情
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
help 接动作时可省略 to；接事情可使用 with，不写 help someone doing。

example.text: Learning about local values and norms can help visitors develop cultural sensitivity.
example.translation: 了解当地的价值观和规范，可以帮助游客培养文化敏感性。

c-sentence-08-024.pattern: Tourism gives a country opportunities to present itself to the world and raise its international profile.
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
表示做某事的机会；不定式说明机会的内容。

example.text: Tourism gives a country opportunities to present itself to the world and raise its international profile.
example.translation: 旅游让一个国家有机会向世界展示自身，并提升国际知名度。

c-sentence-08-026.pattern: International travel can make local cultures and cuisines better known around the world.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: International travel can make local cultures and cuisines better known around the world.
example.translation: 国际旅行可以让当地文化和美食更加为世界所知。

c-sentence-08-031.pattern: Visitors can celebrate a destination's distinctive culture while planning carefully for dietary restrictions and food allergies.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
while 可表示对照或同时发生；根据句意判断两部分关系。

example.text: Visitors can celebrate a destination's distinctive culture while planning carefully for dietary restrictions and food allergies.
example.translation: 游客可以欣赏目的地的独特文化，同时妥善考虑饮食限制和食物过敏。

c-sentence-08-032.pattern: Large volumes of tourist travel can exacerbate environmental pressures.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: Large volumes of tourist travel can exacerbate environmental pressures.
example.translation: 大规模游客流动可能加剧环境压力。

c-sentence-08-033.pattern: Land and sea travel often involve fossil fuel consumption and associated carbon emissions.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: Land and sea travel often involve fossil fuel consumption and associated carbon emissions.
example.translation: 陆路和海路旅行常涉及化石燃料消耗以及相关的碳排放。

c-sentence-08-035.pattern: Hotels, heating, catering and transport can all affect the surrounding environment.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: Hotels, heating, catering and transport can all affect the surrounding environment.
example.translation: 酒店、供暖、餐饮和交通都可能影响周边环境。

c-sentence-08-036.pattern: Some tourism jobs are seasonal and insecure, with relatively low pay and limited skill requirements.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: Some tourism jobs are seasonal and insecure, with relatively low pay and limited skill requirements.
example.translation: 一些旅游业岗位具有季节性且不稳定，工资相对较低，对技能的要求也有限。

c-sentence-08-037.pattern: Tourism businesses may exploit workers when commercial exchanges are not supported by effective labour protections.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
when 引出时间或条件，注意它与主句的对应关系。

example.text: Tourism businesses may exploit workers when commercial exchanges are not supported by effective labour protections.
example.translation: 当商业交易缺乏有效劳动保护时，旅游企业可能剥削劳动者。

c-sentence-08-038.pattern: Excessive cultural commercialisation can undermine the core values of a tourist destination.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: Excessive cultural commercialisation can undermine the core values of a tourist destination.
example.translation: 过度的文化商业化可能损害旅游目的地的核心价值。

c-sentence-08-044.pattern: Holidaymakers may offend local communities if they behave disrespectfully towards other cultures.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
if 引出条件，避免把有条件的结论写成绝对结论。

example.text: Holidaymakers may offend local communities if they behave disrespectfully towards other cultures.
example.translation: 度假者如果不尊重其他文化，可能冒犯当地社区。

c-sentence-09-015.pattern: A growing advertising industry can create jobs and generate tax revenue for the government.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: A growing advertising industry can create jobs and generate tax revenue for the government.
example.translation: 不断发展的广告业可以创造就业机会，并为政府带来税收。

c-sentence-09-032.pattern: Some commercials introduce healthier dietary options, although consumers still need to assess the claims critically.
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
although 引出让步，主句说明限制条件下仍成立的观点。
to 后用动词原形；保留前面动词所表达的需要、尝试或倾向。

example.text: Some commercials introduce healthier dietary options, although consumers still need to assess the claims critically.
example.translation: 一些商业广告介绍较健康的饮食选择，但消费者仍需审慎评估其宣传。

c-sentence-09-044.pattern: Advertising may raise ethical concerns when it promotes smoking, excessive drinking or a lifestyle centred on unrestricted consumption.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
when 引出时间或条件，注意它与主句的对应关系。

example.text: Advertising may raise ethical concerns when it promotes smoking, excessive drinking or a lifestyle centred on unrestricted consumption.
example.translation: 当广告鼓吹吸烟、过度饮酒或以无节制消费为中心的生活方式时，可能引发伦理担忧。

c-sentence-09-046.pattern: Advertising high-fat and high-sugar foods may encourage dietary habits associated with obesity and diabetes.
collocations: 按动词含义选择对象 + to do
enable / allow / encourage / require + 人 + to do
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
enable 表示使能够，allow 表示允许，encourage 表示鼓励，require 表示要求，motivate 表示激励。
接人的动作时用对象 + to do；若直接接名词，则表示促进、允许或要求某事。

example.text: Advertising high-fat and high-sugar foods may encourage dietary habits associated with obesity and diabetes.
example.translation: 宣传高脂、高糖食品的广告，可能鼓励与肥胖和糖尿病相关的不良饮食习惯。

c-sentence-09-051.pattern: Large-scale competitive advertising may trigger an advertising war and increase companies' costs.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: Large-scale competitive advertising may trigger an advertising war and increase companies' costs.
example.translation: 大规模的竞争性广告可能引发广告战，并增加企业成本。

c-sentence-09-052.pattern: Small firms may face unequal competition because they cannot match large companies' advertising budgets.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
because 引出原因从句，要保留主语和谓语。

example.text: Small firms may face unequal competition because they cannot match large companies' advertising budgets.
example.translation: 小企业可能面临不平等竞争，因为它们无法匹敌大公司的广告预算。

c-sentence-09-053.pattern: Heavy advertising by dominant firms may drive smaller businesses out of the market and increase the risk of monopoly.
collocations: risk / probability / likelihood of + 名词或 doing
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
of 引出风险或概率对应的事件。

example.text: Heavy advertising by dominant firms may drive smaller businesses out of the market and increase the risk of monopoly.
example.translation: 占优势企业的大量广告投放，可能将小企业挤出市场，增加垄断风险。

c-sentence-09-058.pattern: Poorly managed landfills can damage local ecosystems.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: Poorly managed landfills can damage local ecosystems.
example.translation: 管理不善的垃圾填埋场可能破坏当地生态系统。

c-sentence-09-068.pattern: Because advertising can create unrealistic wants among children, legislation may restrict advertisements aimed at them.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
because 引出原因从句，要保留主语和谓语。

example.text: Because advertising can create unrealistic wants among children, legislation may restrict advertisements aimed at them.
example.translation: 由于广告可能在儿童中制造不切实际的欲望，法律可以限制面向儿童的广告。

c-sentence-09-070.pattern: Parents can use child-friendly settings on electronic devices to reduce children's exposure to inappropriate content.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: Parents can use child-friendly settings on electronic devices to reduce children's exposure to inappropriate content.
example.translation: 家长可以使用电子设备的儿童友好设置，减少孩子接触不适当内容的机会。

c-sentence-10-004.pattern: News coverage can educate people about health, the environment and other public issues.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: News coverage can educate people about health, the environment and other public issues.
example.translation: 新闻报道可以帮助人们了解健康、环境和其他公共议题。

c-sentence-10-006.pattern: Consulting different news sources can help readers develop a fuller picture of an event.
collocations: help + 人 + (to) do / help with + 事情
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
help 接动作时可省略 to；接事情可使用 with，不写 help someone doing。

example.text: Consulting different news sources can help readers develop a fuller picture of an event.
example.translation: 查阅不同新闻来源，可以帮助读者更全面地了解一件事。

c-sentence-10-009.pattern: Low-cost online news can attract readers and help businesses reach potential customers more quickly and easily.
collocations: help + 人 + (to) do / help with + 事情
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
help 接动作时可省略 to；接事情可使用 with，不写 help someone doing。

example.text: Low-cost online news can attract readers and help businesses reach potential customers more quickly and easily.
example.translation: 低成本的在线新闻可以吸引读者，并帮助企业更快捷、更容易地接触潜在顾客。

c-sentence-10-011.pattern: News outlets can spread art and culture by showcasing different cultural practices.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: News outlets can spread art and culture by showcasing different cultural practices.
example.translation: 新闻媒体可以通过展示不同文化实践，传播艺术和文化。

c-sentence-10-015.pattern: Digital media can expose users to impersonation, fraud and hacking if safeguards are inadequate.
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
if 引出条件，避免把有条件的结论写成绝对结论。
两个宾语位置要齐全：让谁接触什么。

example.text: Digital media can expose users to impersonation, fraud and hacking if safeguards are inadequate.
example.translation: 如果保护措施不足，数字媒体可能让用户面临冒充身份、诈骗和黑客攻击的风险。

c-sentence-10-016.pattern: News can be distorted, allowing disinformation to spread.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: News can be distorted, allowing disinformation to spread.
example.translation: 新闻可能被歪曲，从而使蓄意虚假信息得以传播。

c-sentence-10-017.pattern: Compulsive media use can distract people and reduce their productivity.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: Compulsive media use can distract people and reduce their productivity.
example.translation: 难以控制的媒体使用可能分散人们的注意力，降低生产效率。

c-sentence-10-018.pattern: Selective or misleading news can manipulate public opinion and discourage readers from questioning the message.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: Selective or misleading news can manipulate public opinion and discourage readers from questioning the message.
example.translation: 选择性或误导性的新闻可能操纵公众舆论，使读者不愿质疑信息。

c-sentence-10-020.pattern: Long periods of screen use may cause eye strain, while listening at excessive volume can pose risks to hearing.
collocations: 原因或行为 + 因果表达 + 结果
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
while 可表示对照或同时发生；根据句意判断两部分关系。
区分“导致”与“有助于”；用于论证时需要说明机制，不能仅靠搭配认定因果。

example.text: Long periods of screen use may cause eye strain, while listening at excessive volume can pose risks to hearing.
example.translation: 长时间使用屏幕可能引起眼疲劳，而音量过大的收听可能危害听力。

c-sentence-10-021.pattern: Media habits that replace physical activity may encourage a sedentary lifestyle and increase health risks associated with obesity.
collocations: 按动词含义选择对象 + to do
enable / allow / encourage / require + 人 + to do
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
enable 表示使能够，allow 表示允许，encourage 表示鼓励，require 表示要求，motivate 表示激励。
接人的动作时用对象 + to do；若直接接名词，则表示促进、允许或要求某事。

example.text: Media habits that replace physical activity may encourage a sedentary lifestyle and increase health risks associated with obesity.
example.translation: 如果媒体使用取代了身体活动，可能鼓励久坐生活方式，并增加与肥胖相关的健康风险。

c-sentence-10-022.pattern: Doom-laden headlines may attract attention by exaggerating the sense of danger.
collocations: a sense of + 抽象名词
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
表示某种感觉或意识，如 a sense of achievement。

example.text: Doom-laden headlines may attract attention by exaggerating the sense of danger.
example.translation: 充满灾难色彩的标题，可能通过夸大危险感来吸引注意力。

c-sentence-10-023.pattern: Repeated exposure to alarming reports may instil negative feelings and nurture unnecessary fear.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。

example.text: Repeated exposure to alarming reports may instil negative feelings and nurture unnecessary fear.
example.translation: 反复接触令人担忧的报道，可能带来负面情绪，滋生不必要的恐惧。

c-sentence-10-026.pattern: Coverage of private lives can influence people's behaviour, while repeated exposure to dominant cultural models may encourage cultural assimilation.
collocations: 按动词含义选择对象 + to do
enable / allow / encourage / require + 人 + to do
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
while 可表示对照或同时发生；根据句意判断两部分关系。
enable 表示使能够，allow 表示允许，encourage 表示鼓励，require 表示要求，motivate 表示激励。
接人的动作时用对象 + to do；若直接接名词，则表示促进、允许或要求某事。

example.text: Coverage of private lives can influence people's behaviour, while repeated exposure to dominant cultural models may encourage cultural assimilation.
example.translation: 对私生活的报道可能影响人们的行为，而反复接触占优势的文化模式可能促进文化同化。

c-sentence-10-028.pattern: As a traditional form of media, newspapers may enjoy public trust when they maintain reliable reporting standards.
collocations: avoid / enjoy / consider + 名词或 doing
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
when 引出时间或条件，注意它与主句的对应关系。
如果后面表示动作，用动名词，通常不接 to do。

example.text: As a traditional form of media, newspapers may enjoy public trust when they maintain reliable reporting standards.
example.translation: 报纸作为传统媒体形式，如果保持可靠的报道标准，可能获得公众信任。

c-sentence-10-029.pattern: Informative newspapers can help readers examine social problems from different perspectives.
collocations: help + 人 + (to) do / help with + 事情
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
help 接动作时可省略 to；接事情可使用 with，不写 help someone doing。

example.text: Informative newspapers can help readers examine social problems from different perspectives.
example.translation: 信息丰富的报纸可以帮助读者从不同角度审视社会问题。

c-sentence-10-030.pattern: Detailed reporting can provide readers with valuable information.
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
人先写，事物后写；另一结构是 provide + 事物 + for + 人。

example.text: Detailed reporting can provide readers with valuable information.
example.translation: 详尽的报道可以为读者提供有价值的信息。

c-sentence-10-031.pattern: Rigorous fact-checking can make reporting more authoritative and less misleading, although strict censorship does not itself guarantee accuracy.
collocations: 完整句子的主语 + 谓语 + 补充信息
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
although 引出让步，主句说明限制条件下仍成立的观点。

example.text: Rigorous fact-checking can make reporting more authoritative and less misleading, although strict censorship does not itself guarantee accuracy.
example.translation: 严格的事实核查可以增强报道的可信度、减少误导，但严格的信息审查本身并不保证准确。

c-sentence-10-032.pattern: Newspapers can help cultivate reading habits and support an informed public discussion.
collocations: help + 人 + (to) do / help with + 事情
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
help 接动作时可省略 to；接事情可使用 with，不写 help someone doing。

example.text: Newspapers can help cultivate reading habits and support an informed public discussion.
example.translation: 报纸可以帮助培养阅读习惯，支持建立在充分信息之上的公共讨论。

c-sentence-10-033.pattern: Not everyone has access to digital news, including some older people who face barriers to using technology.
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
to 是介词；access 在此是名词，不要写 access of。
名词 access 后接 to；作动词时则直接写 access + 资源。

example.text: Not everyone has access to digital news, including some older people who face barriers to using technology.
example.translation: 并非人人都能获取数字新闻，包括部分在使用技术方面面临障碍的老年人。

c-sentence-10-039.pattern: Extended screen time may cause headaches or fatigue for some readers.
collocations: 原因或行为 + 因果表达 + 结果
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
区分“导致”与“有助于”；用于论证时需要说明机制，不能仅靠搭配认定因果。

example.text: Extended screen time may cause headaches or fatigue for some readers.
example.translation: 长时间看屏幕可能让部分读者感到头痛或疲劳。

c-sentence-10-040.pattern: Some readers find physical copies more comfortable to use than an impersonal electronic screen.
collocations: 比较级 + than + 比较对象
notes: 按完整意思组织主语、谓语和补充信息；下面的搭配拆解只用于理解，练习仍要求写出整句。
than 后补足比较基准；比较对象应在同一维度。

example.text: Some readers find physical copies more comfortable to use than an impersonal electronic screen.
example.translation: 一些读者认为，与缺乏亲切感的电子屏幕相比，纸质读物使用起来更舒适。

c-sentence-20-020.pattern: Artworks can provide material for historical research and encourage related spending, such as purchases of souvenirs.
